description: This Java interface file defines the LogicDataSource interface for the OpenMRS logic module, which provides data retrieval methods for different data sources used in patient data logic evaluations.

classes.name: LogicDataSource
classes.description: A Java interface for data sources used in the OpenMRS logic module, responsible for retrieving patient data based on specified criteria within a given context.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Extracts data from the data source for a given logic context, cohort of patients, and criteria. Returns a map of results grouped by patient ID.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the collection of data keys that this data source can provide.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if the specified key is available in this data source.

methods.name: getDefaultTTL
methods.description: Returns the default time-to-live for cached data in this data source.
